## Context
The generated configuration reference enumerates key, type, default, and lifecycle data from typed dataclass fields but provides no public setting descriptions. It cannot serve as the external settings contract until each emitted key explains its user-visible effect. F19 explicitly authorizes this Description-column enrichment as corrective follow-on scope beyond the closed generator baseline; generated ownership remains unchanged.

## Plan
- Add concise `public_description` metadata to every dataclass field emitted through `_SECTION_CLASSES`, co-located with each field so generator introspection remains the single source of truth and a sidecar description registry cannot drift.
- Preserve field types, defaults, factories, coercion, and runtime behavior.
- Extend `scripts/gen_config_reference.py` to require nonempty description metadata and render a Description column.
- Fail generation when an emitted field lacks a description.
- Regenerate `docs/config-reference.md`.
- Add focused completeness, escaping, and drift tests.
- Review every generated Description cell against its key plus adjacent Type, Default, and Lifecycle cells; require a user-visible effect or operational consequence rather than a restatement, then record that completed editorial review in a ticket comment.
- Keep `src/rebar` modules below the absolute 800-line limit. Use an existing configuration-section seam if an extraction is required.

## Testing
- `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check`
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py tests/unit/test_config_typed.py tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py -q`
- `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check && test $(wc -l < src/rebar/_config_schema.py) -le $(cat .github/module-size-limit.txt)`
- `make lint && make typecheck`
- Manual proof: inspect every generated Description row against its Key, Type, Default, and Lifecycle cells; record the completed row-by-row review in a ticket comment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every generated typed key has one nonempty public description.
- [ ] The generator fails with the missing key named when metadata is absent.
- [ ] Each description identifies a user-visible effect or operational consequence.
- [ ] No description merely restates its row type.
- [ ] No description merely restates its row default.
- [ ] No description merely restates its row lifecycle.
- [ ] Generated Markdown escapes table-sensitive content correctly.
- [ ] Typed field annotations remain unchanged.
- [ ] Default values remain unchanged.
- [ ] Default factories remain unchanged.
- [ ] Configuration coercion remains unchanged.
- [ ] Configuration runtime behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] `_config_schema.py` remains within the absolute module-size limit.
- [ ] Focused generator tests pass.
- [ ] Focused typed-configuration tests pass.
- [ ] Lint passes.
- [ ] Type checking passes.
